cmd:
for i in $(seq 1 26); do
  if grep -q "==== B" /tmp/research.log 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  if ! pgrep -f robot_research.py >/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
sed -n '/==== A/,/^$/p' /tmp/research.log
echo ----
tail -n 3 /tmp/research.log
pgrep -f robot_research.py >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo FINISHED
